title: Who is Kick streamer Nanatty? Viral clip sparks backlash over alleged racist remarks on livestream
summary_full: Japanese Kick streamer Nanatty is under fire after a video surfaced online, appearing to show her using a racial slur while interacting with another streamer. Viewers have also pointed out her derogatory remarks about Black individuals. This incident marks another chapter in a series of controversies for Nanatty during her livestreams, yet neither she nor Kick have responded publicly to the allegations at this time.
